exposure: reduced oxygen tension (5% O2) during embryo culture
atmospheric oxygen (20% O2) during embryo culture
cohort: The cohort consisted of 13,831 singleton live births resulting from fresh cleavage-stage IVF/ICSI transfers.
finding: Reduced oxygen tension during embryo culture was associated with longer gestation, lower neonatal birthweight and Z-scores, an increased risk of SGA, and a decreased incidence of LGA or macrosomia, with no difference in preterm birth.
